papers.title: Proportional Multiaxial Fatigue Behavior and Life Prediction of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Ti-6Al-4V with Critical Plane-Based Building Direction Variations
papers.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) is an additive manufacturing technique that enables the fabrication of complex geometries through a layer-by-layer approach, overcoming limitations of conventional manufacturing. In this study, multiaxial low-cycle fatigue (MLCF) tests were conducted on L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) specimens built in four different orientations, selected based on critical plane orientations identified from rolled titanium. Under proportional strain-controlled loading, the cyclic softening behavior, mean stress response, and fracture mechanisms of the material were systematically investigated. The results show that L-PBF Ti64 exhibits a three-stage softening characteristic (continuous softening, stable, and rapid softening). Fatigue cracks primarily initiate from inner-surface lack-of-fusion defects. Crack propagation shows cleavage and quasi-cleavage characteristics with tearing ridges, river patterns, and multi-directional striations. Proposed KBMP life prediction model, incorporating λ and building direction parameters, was developed. The KBMP-λ model demonstrates optimal accuracy, providing a reliable tool for the design of L-PBF titanium components subjected to complex multiaxial fatigue loading with relative errors within 20%.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的多轴疲劳行为及寿命预测，完全符合L1力学与疲劳方向的需求。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover post-processing treatments (e.g., HIP, heat treatment) or femoral stem implant applications; it is a pure as-built mechanical/fatigue characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V在不同构建方向下的多轴低周疲劳行为。
summary_zh.method: 基于临界平面法设计四种构建方向，进行比例应变控制的多轴疲劳试验，并提出KBMP-λ寿命预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 材料呈现三阶段软化特征，裂纹从内部未熔合缺陷萌生，寿命预测误差在20%以内。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多轴疲劳实验数据验证模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the proportional multiaxial low-cycle fatigue behavior of laser powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V with varying building orientations based on critical plane considerations.
summary_en.method: Multiaxial fatigue tests under proportional strain-controlled loading were performed on specimens built in four orientations, and a KBMP life prediction model incorporating building direction parameters (λ) was developed.
summary_en.result: The material exhibits a three-stage cyclic softening response, fatigue cracks initiate from internal lack-of-fusion defects, and the proposed KBMP-λ model predicts fatigue life within 20% error.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated against experimental multiaxial fatigue test data.

papers.title: Microstructural Evolution and Properties of In Situ Synthesized Ceramic-Phase Reinforced Ti-Al Composite Coatings Fabricated by Coaxial Powder Feeding Laser Cladding
papers.abstract: The Ti-Al-Si composite coatings were effectively fabricated on Ti6Al4V (TC4) substrates via coaxial powder feeding laser cladding technology. This study systematically investigated the influence of in situ synthesized Ti-Si ceramic reinforcement phases and Si content on the microstructure, microhardness, and wear resistance of the composite coatings. An excellent metallurgical bond between the coating and the substrate can be formed during the cladding coating process. When the temperature of the molten pool drops, the Ti and Si elements in situ react to form a Ti5Si3 ceramic reinforced phase originating from the Si-rich zone in the liquid phase. The microhardness of the cladding coatings exhibits a positive correlation with increasing Si content, reaching a maximum value of 820.83 HV. The in situ synthetic Ti5Si3 ceramic reinforced phases can effectively improve the coating’s wear resistance. Notably, the laser cladding coating with 25 wt% Si content exhibits the lowest wear weight loss rate of 0.140 mg·min−1 and the lowest average friction coefficient of 0.412. Analysis of the wear mechanism reveals a combination of adhesive wear and microscopic wear characteristics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是TC4表面激光熔覆制备Ti-Al-Si复合涂层的微观结构和性能，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能，与用户关注方向不符。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies in-situ synthesized ceramic-reinforced Ti-Al-Si composite coatings on Ti6Al4V substrates via laser cladding, not the mechanical or fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高TC4表面硬度和耐磨性
summary_zh.method: 同轴送粉激光熔覆制备Ti-Al-Si复合涂层
summary_zh.result: 添加25%Si时硬度最高(820.83 HV),磨损率最低

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the surface hardness and wear resistance of Ti6Al4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Coaxial powder feeding laser cladding was used to fabricate Ti-Al-Si composite coatings with in situ synthesized Ti5Si3 ceramic phases.
summary_en.result: The coating with 25 wt% Si content achieved a maximum microhardness of 820.83 HV and the lowest wear rate.
summary_en.validation: Vickers microhardness testing and wear weight loss measurements.

papers.title: Effect on deep cryogenic cycling treatment and combined double-sided laser shock peening with coating of microstructure evolution and mechanical properties of annealing Ti-6Al-4V alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology

corresponding_authors.name: M. Saravanakumar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V合金的后处理，但未针对增材制造件，与用户关注的AM Ti-6Al-4V后处理方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address additive-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it studies post-processing on conventional wrought/annealed alloy, which is outside the scope of AM-specific post-processing effects.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究深冷循环与激光冲击喷丸复合处理对Ti-6Al-4V合金组织与力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对退火态Ti-6Al-4V合金进行深冷循环处理和双面激光冲击喷丸涂层处理。
summary_zh.result: 复合处理显著细化了显微组织并提高了强度与硬度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微表征和室温拉伸/硬度测试验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the combined effect of deep cryogenic cycling and double-sided laser shock peening with coating on the microstructure and mechanical properties of annealed Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Annealed Ti-6Al-4V alloy was subjected to deep cryogenic cycling followed by double-sided laser shock peening with a protective coating.
summary_en.result: The combined treatment significantly refined the microstructure and enhanced the strength and hardness of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural characterization and room-temperature tensile and hardness tests.
